# MM Sperryas - Fulfill the Promise

> > Middle school social studies and science teacher blog featuring weekly lesson plans for 7th and 8th grade covering American history, world civilizations, and life sciences.

This educational blog documents weekly classroom activities, homework assignments, and curriculum resources for middle school students. The site focuses on American Revolutionary history, ancient civilizations (China, India, Egypt, Mesopotamia), and science topics including genetics and cell biology, with an emphasis on primary sources and documentary film analysis.

## Key Topics

- 7th Grade Curriculum
- 8th Grade Curriculum
- American Revolution
- French and Indian War
- Ancient Civilizations (China, India, Egypt, Mesopotamia)
- Bill of Rights & Constitutional Studies
- George Washington & Founding Fathers
- The Last of the Mohicans (Historical Analysis)
- Global Education Access
- Colonial American History
- Weekly Lesson Plans
- Homework Assignments
- Documentary Film Studies
- Primary Source Analysis
- DOJO Classroom Management
